title: document-index.v1
description: S075 (#227). The index of a financial document store. Identity is the sha256, COMPUTED on arrival and never accepted from input — the same rule accounting-tracker.v1 applies to a due date. `posted_ref` is what closes document -> validated rows -> posted entry; an entry without one is an OPEN ITEM, derived rather than flagged, so no caller can mark a document closed without naming what it became. Corrections are new entries with `superseded_by` on the old one: the original was the basis of a filed return and is replaced in the books, not removed from the record.

sha256.description: IDENTITY. Computed from the stored bytes. Detects duplicates, makes re-ingestion idempotent, and proves the file behind a figure has not changed.

original_filename.description: What the sender called it — often the only clue when a reference is missing.

stored_path.description: Relative to the store root. COMPUTED from doc_type and period, so the tree stays period-first.

period.description: The period the document BELONGS to — not the date it arrived.

tax_point.description: The date that drives VAT — the SUPPLY, not arrival and not payment. Null means not established, which is different from same-as-received.

extracted.description: Whether rows were extracted and whether they passed the §4 validation contract. `failed` means the figures are a query, not a transaction.

posted_ref.description: The journal or transaction it became. Null is an OPEN ITEM and belongs in the period-end review.

superseded_by.description: sha256 of the document that replaced this one. The superseded entry is never deleted.
